media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The advertisement was published in the German trade paper Der Kinematograph, no. 2 (1932), without a designer’s credit, so it is treated as an anonymous work whose German term of seventy years from publication ran out at the end of 2002. It was therefore still protected on 1 January 1996 and the URAA restored United States copyright for ninety-five years from publication, to the end of 2027. The Media History Digital Library permits use of material in its collection in teaching, research and publications, but that permission covers the digitised volume it supplies and not the copyright in the advertisement. An attributed excerpt is used here for scholarly documentation. The local copy is reduced to 606 × 800 px.
